title: PUT /users/{userId}/profile — Request Body
description: Sets or updates the patient injury profile collected during onboarding.

injuryType.description: Injury classification string, e.g. ACL, rotator_cuff, knee_replacement

surgeryDate.description: ISO 8601 calendar date of surgery (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if not applicable

constraints.description: Movement restriction tags applied to exercise selection, e.g. ['no_impact', 'limited_range']
